title: Sunset Yacht Charter
summary: Private yacht experience along the pristine coastline
description: Sail along Egypt's stunning North Coast aboard a luxury yacht as the sun sets over the Mediterranean. Enjoy premium refreshments, water activities, and breathtaking coastal views on this unforgettable maritime adventure.

title: Beach Club Experience
summary: Exclusive access to premium beach clubs
description: Relax in style at the North Coast's most exclusive beach clubs. Enjoy VIP cabana service, gourmet cuisine, refreshing cocktails, and access to pristine private beaches with crystal-clear waters.

title: Water Sports Adventure
summary: Thrilling water activities for adventure seekers
description: Experience the Mediterranean's crystal waters through exciting activities including jet skiing, parasailing, windsurfing, and diving. Professional instructors ensure safety while maximizing the thrill.

title: Coastal Dining Experience
summary: Gourmet Mediterranean cuisine with ocean views
description: Savor fresh seafood and Mediterranean specialties at beachfront restaurants. Experience culinary excellence while dining with your toes in the sand and the sound of waves as your soundtrack.

title: Spa & Wellness Retreat
description: Indulge in world-class spa treatments featuring marine-based therapies, aromatherapy massages, and wellness rituals designed to refresh your body and mind in luxurious beachfront settings.

title: Marina Nightlife
summary: Vibrant evening entertainment at luxury marinas
description: Experience the North Coast's sophisticated nightlife scene at world-class marinas. Enjoy craft cocktails, live music, and dancing under the stars with stunning yacht-filled harbor views.

title: Sunset Sand-Surfing
summary: Ride down golden dunes on custom boards as the sun dips behind the Great Sand Sea.
description: Experience the thrill of sand surfing down the massive dunes of the Great Sand Sea. Our expert guides provide custom sand boards and safety equipment for an unforgettable desert adventure. Watch the sunset paint the dunes in golden hues while you glide down the soft sand slopes.

title: Salt Lake Float Therapy
summary: Float effortlessly in mineral-rich salt lakes with therapeutic properties.
description: Immerse yourself in the healing waters of Siwa's famous salt lakes. The high mineral content allows you to float effortlessly while absorbing beneficial salts and minerals through your skin. This natural therapy has been used for centuries to treat skin conditions and promote relaxation.

title: Oracle Temple Pilgrimage
summary: Explore the ancient Oracle Temple where Alexander the Great sought divine guidance.
description: Visit the legendary Temple of the Oracle, one of the most important religious sites in ancient Egypt. Walk in the footsteps of Alexander the Great and learn about the sacred rituals that took place here. Our expert guides share the fascinating history and mythology of this UNESCO World Heritage site.

title: Desert Stargazing Experience
summary: Where the infinite sky becomes your evening's entertainment.
description: Far from city lights, the desert opens up into a celestial theatre. As you recline on soft cushions or settle into wicker chairs, the cool night air brushes against your skin. The first stars twinkle shyly before the heavens erupt into a dazzling display—the Milky Way stretching like a luminous river across the inky black. A guide, armed with a telescope and a passion for the cosmos, draws your eyes to planets glowing like lanterns, constellations telling stories as old as humanity, and the occasional streak of a shooting star. The silence of the desert is deep, broken only by hushed voices, laughter, and the quiet hum of awe. It's more than just looking up—it's feeling your place in the vastness, sharing a moment of wonder with those beside you, and leaving with memories etched as vividly as the stars themselves.

title: Cleopatra Spring Soak
summary: Bathe in the legendary spring where Cleopatra once relaxed.
description: Nestled among fragrant date palms and sun-bleached palm fronds, Cleopatra Spring offers a serene oasis experience where ancient royalty once bathed. The naturally warm, mineral-rich waters bubble up from deep underground, creating a perfect circular pool surrounded by lush greenery.

title: Desert Breathwork Meditation
summary: Guided breathwork sessions in the heart of the Western Desert.
description: Immerse yourself in the stillness of the Western Desert with guided breathwork meditation sessions. Connect with ancient wisdom traditions while practicing conscious breathing techniques surrounded by the vast silence of the Sahara.

title: Sleeping Under the Stars
summary: Experience the magic of the Siwa Oasis night sky in an intimate desert camping adventure.
description: Under the vast Siwa Oasis sky, sleeping beneath the stars is nothing short of magical. As the desert night embraces you, the air turns cool and still, carrying only the soft whisper of the wind through the dunes. Above, the Milky Way stretches like a river of diamonds, so vivid it feels close enough to touch.

title: Sunset Horseback Ride
summary: A private horseback ride at sunset in Siwa is pure desert poetry.
description: Your journey begins beneath the swaying palms, where the scent of date trees mingles with the warm desert breeze. As you ride out of the oasis, the golden light softens, and the horizon begins to glow with the colours of an approaching sunset. The world around you feels still—except for the rhythmic sound of your horse's hooves on the sand and the gentle swish of its tail. Soon, the open desert unfolds before you, a vast canvas of rippling dunes and shimmering salt lakes. Your guide, an expert horseman, leads you to hidden vantage points where the setting sun spills molten gold across the sands. In the distance, the silhouette of a galloping Arabian horse captures the spirit of freedom that defines Siwa. As twilight deepens, you ride alongside your partner or alone with your thoughts, the desert painted in hues of amber, rose, and violet. The first stars begin to appear, and the air cools, wrapping you in the serenity only the desert can offer. It's not just a ride—it's an intimate, timeless moment where you feel a profound connection to the land, the horse beneath you, and the person beside you.

title: Flamingo Watching Experience
summary: A serene encounter with nature's elegance.
description: At dawn or dusk, when the desert sky blushes in shades of gold and rose, the salt lakes of Siwa transform into a living mirror. Here, flocks of graceful flamingos gather, their long necks arching in perfect harmony as they wade through shimmering waters. The scene is almost surreal—fiery reflections dance around their pale pink feathers, and the stillness of the lake magnifies every ripple they make. As you stand quietly on the shore, the air is filled with the soft calls of distant birds and the gentle lapping of water. You might witness them take flight, their wings painting streaks of pink and black against the endless horizon, or watch them forage, their movements slow and deliberate, like a choreographed dance. This is more than birdwatching—it's a moment of pure connection with the rhythms of the natural world, a chance to feel the peaceful heartbeat of Siwa's wild side.
